## Phase: 16 - Enforce the Loop

### Hook exit code contract
from: [[wiki:hook-exit-codes]]
retrieved: 2026-05-22

- Exit 0 = allow (tool use proceeds), exit 2 = block (stderr shown to Claude)
- PreToolUse hooks receive tool input JSON on stdin with `input.file_path`
- Stop hooks receive session context JSON with `tool_uses` array on stdin

### Existing hook patterns
from: [[decision:python-json-parsing-hooks]]
retrieved: 2026-05-22

- Python inline (`python3 -c '...'`) for JSON parsing, ~20ms, within 100ms budget
- check-tests-were-run.sh pattern: detect signal, check condition, block or allow
- Fail-open default in LLM pipelines; deterministic hooks at boundaries are primary defense

### Global distribution with opt-in
from: [[decision:global-hooks-project-opt-in]]
retrieved: 2026-05-22

- Hooks install to ~/.claude/hooks/ (global), check CWD for .claude/enforce marker (per-project)
- install.sh JSON merge for hooks section in settings.json (append to arrays, don't overwrite)
- Marker created by install.sh --all; absent marker = exit 0 immediately

### Deliverable verification scope
from: [[decision:lightweight-deliverable-check-stop]]
retrieved: 2026-05-22

- Stop hook runs only file-existence exit criteria (test -f, test -d) from specs/<slug>.md
- Open tasks and debrief status are advisory stdout, NOT blocking exit 2
- Path allowlist: .dev-wiki/, .claude/, wiki/, specs/, tests/, templates/, *_test.*, test_*.*, *_spec.*, *.md
